ValidationRule.description: Require SubCategory for Experience Center when closing case from functional group Help Desk and Category is Finances (Help Desk) excluding Closed : SPAM
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( (CC_Functional_Group__r.Name = "Help Desk" ), OR((CC_Category__r.Name = "Finances (Help Desk)" ), (CC_Category__r.Name= "Information Technology (Help Desk)") ), (ISBLANK(TEXT( Sub_Category__c ))), ($User.ProfileId <> "00ed00000017Iob"), OR ( ISPICKVAL (Status, "Closed: Cancellation"), ISPICKVAL (Status, "Closed: Customer Self-Resolved"), ISPICKVAL (Status, "Closed: Customer Unresponsive"), ISPICKVAL (Status, "Closed: Duplicate"), ISPICKVAL (Status, "Closed: Forwarded"), ISPICKVAL (Status, "Closed: No Show"), ISPICKVAL (Status, "Closed: Resolved")) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please provide a Sub-Category when Functional group is Help Desk and Category is either Finances (Help Desk) or Category is Information Technology (Help Desk).
